svg.title: 历史条件搜索与后继收益提交研究框架
svg.desc: Panels a-b and d show the completed Stage-113 generated/shared baseline with frozen SGLA and a shared IoU regressor. Panel c is the separate Stage-120 offline matched-action study, not a deployed continuous gate. Gaussian states, images, response maps and the highlighted SGLA layer are schematic. GT in the scorer denotes an offline fitting target only. No PPO, diffusion, or online SGLA template update is represented.
